name: How much does it cost to replace kitchen cabinets and countertops?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace kitchen cabinets and countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace kitchen cabinets and countertops varies significantly based on material selection, kitchen size, and labor. Custom cabinets can be much more expensive than semi-custom or stock options. Similarly, high-end countertop materials like exotic granite or premium quartz will cost more than laminate or basic solid surface. Installation complexity also plays a role. A general estimate for a full kitchen remodel involving both can range from $15,000 to $50,000 or more, depending on your choices. We provide detailed, itemized quotes after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on materials, kitchen size, and labor. Estimates can range from $15,000 to over $50,000 for a full replacement.
